clue.text: Swedish physicist showing uneasiness over computer memory

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits over, above, the second

parts.note: angst is a feeling of anxiety or dread
ROM is read-only memory in a computer

explanation.surface: A Swedish scientist is anxious about the memory in his computer.
explanation.walkthrough: Anders Ångström gave his name to a unit of length used for wavelengths.
explanation.definitionFit: Anders Ångström was a nineteenth-century Swedish physicist, a pioneer of spectroscopy.

clue.text: Letting go, suppressing a sudden pounce

parts.note: sparing a captive means letting them go free

clue.text: Ships — a good many brought in to replenish Armada, ultimately

parts.note: to replenish is to fill up again
a lot means a large number

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of Armada

explanation.surface: Many vessels are drafted in to restore the strength of a battle fleet.
explanation.definitionFit: A flotilla is a small fleet, a group of vessels sailing together.

clue.text: Some of fugitives turned up? Nonsense!

indicators.note: in a down clue the run of letters reads upwards, from bottom to top
only some of the letters of the phrase of fugitives are used, a run spanning the two words

explanation.surface: A question about whether a few escapees have been found, dismissed as rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' takes FFUG from 'of fugitives', and 'turned up' turns it around, as this is a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Guff is informal for empty talk or rubbish, used as a dismissive exclamation.

clue.text: Most of crowd coming to English symbol of monarchy

parts.note: a throng is a large crowd of people

explanation.surface: A crowd gathers to see an English emblem of the Crown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Most of' drops the G at the end of THRONG.
explanation.definitionFit: The seat a sovereign sits on stands for royal power itself.

clue.text: OK to avoid some witticisms — time for another?

definitions.note: another witticism, singular, the question mark flagging the stretch

indicators.note: the letters of the clue word OK are kept clear of, so taken out of, the word for witty remarks

parts.note: jokes are witty remarks

explanation.surface: A comedian decides to skip a few gags and asks whether it is time to try a new one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to avoid' removes OK from JOKES, leaving JES. The definition 'another' leans on 'witticisms' earlier in the clue: one more witticism.
explanation.definitionFit: A jest is a joke or witty remark, so it is one more of the witticisms mentioned.

clue.text: Bargain haberdashery items taken back

parts.note: pins are sold by haberdashers, dealers in sewing goods

clue.text: Sound of pleasure subsequently covering sound of disgust

parts.note: later means afterwards, subsequently
ugh is an exclamation of disgust

explanation.definitionFit: Laughing is the noise people make when amused or delighted.

clue.text: Help string player who's missed intro

indicators.note: the musician lacks his opening, so the first letter goes

parts.note: a bassist plays the double bass or bass guitar

explanation.definitionFit: To assist is to help or support someone, a straight synonym.

clue.text: For altering, place that's messy and cold

indicators.note: altering the letters of For means rearranging them

parts.note: a sty, a pigsty, is a byword for a filthy, untidy place

clue.text: Doctor Silver is a bore

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

clue.text: See about translation of bitter words in opera

indicators.note: the word for look goes around the rearranged letters

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or see

indicators.note: translation renders the letters of bitter in a new form

explanation.walkthrough: 'See' is the archaic exclamation LO, as in 'lo and behold'; the anagram letters are IBRETT.
explanation.definitionFit: A libretto is the text of an opera, the lines the singers perform.

clue.text: Bringing forth refined behaviour

definitions.meaning: good manners, the result of a well-mannered upbringing

explanation.definitionFit: Breeding is both the producing of young and the good manners of a cultivated person.

clue.text: Quiet, considerate attitude about one funerary ornament

an urn holds ashes or decorates a tomb

explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts I inside TACT, giving TACIT.
explanation.definitionFit: Taciturn describes someone reserved who says little, uncommunicative.

clue.text: Go overseas? Good to enter Arab state

clue.text: Cocktail? I get agitated about small amount of liquid

explanation.definitionFit: A gimlet is a cocktail of gin and lime juice.

clue.text: Choose a mountaineering accessory

clue.text: Suggest appearing on time

definitions.meaning: to remind or cue someone, as an actor who forgets a line
